notes.body: Looks good to me.  Out of interest, did it crash?  I fixed a similar issue in https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10397 (packet-ieee1722.c).

Out of the 4 places only one was a real problem as the others have a switch condition that ensure there is a value in the table.
